submitted.rationale: Index 62 (Fe0.39 Ni0.18 V0.42) had the highest measured photocurrent: 7.5e-7 A at 2.72 eV. Its XRD shows peaks at Q≈1.93, 2.30 and 2.50 on top of the shared peaks at 1.878, 2.374, 2.647 and 3.559, which look like substrate. I read the extra peaks as an FeVO4-like phase, a known visible-light photoanode. This was the best of only 3 merit measurements, so it is not a confirmed library maximum.

rejected.reason: Fe-rich, with a different phase set (extra peaks at 2.86, 3.04, 3.42, 4.34, possibly spinel or hematite-like); measured 5.3e-7 A, below 62
Same FeVO4-like phase as 62 but richer in V, with a slightly stronger 1.927 peak; measured 5.3e-7 A, below 62
Richer in Fe than 62, and its FeVO4-like peak was weaker and the 2.30 peak missing in XRD; not measured for photocurrent
V-rich; XRD shows a different set of extra peaks (1.965–2.169, 2.962), likely a V-rich phase; not measured for photocurrent
